purpose: Black-box tenancy, authentication, authorization, active-context, and audit contract for the AI Operations Deployment Platform.
assumptions: Registration creates a user and does not create a tenant; the first authenticated owner creates an organization.
Creating an organization establishes the authenticated user as its owner, and creating a workspace establishes that owner membership for the workspace.
The owner/admin membership endpoint accepts an existing user email and role, and returns a membership id.
The active workspace is selected through POST /api/auth/context and is applied to subsequent bearer-authenticated requests; the verifier does not use a database shortcut or a test-only seed endpoint.
F01 vendor/document/review/status/ledger routes remain available behind the same bearer session and active workspace context.

The canonical role set is owner, admin, builder, operator, viewer, auditor. A reviewer name is not substituted for builder or auditor; a documented reviewer alias may be added by the implementation and must be mapped explicitly before it is tested.
Denied reads may return 401, 403, or 404 to avoid cross-scope existence leaks; denied writes may return 401 or 403.
Audit events are returned as items or events with a stable id and event_type or action field. There is no successful audit-event delete operation.
